ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple reportedly explores M8 Ultra AI server and Nvidia NVLink Fusion
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: The Information reported Apple is studying a return to enterprise servers with a future M8 Ultra-based AI inference system and possible Nvidia NVLink Fusion connectivity, tentatively around 2029. Reuters did not independently verify the project, so it is treated as a reported strategic signal rather than confirmed product guidance.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Anthropic signs first Australia data-centre lease for a 2.16GW campus
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Anthropic agreed to lease capacity at a 2.16-gigawatt campus about 250 km from Brisbane, expected to begin operations in 2027 and focused on inference rather than training, pending approvals.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: US lawmakers move to make large data centres bear more grid-upgrade costs
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: A bipartisan House proposal would direct regulators to assess whether large data centres and other high-load users should pay incremental grid infrastructure costs, potentially raising the effective cost of AI capacity expansion.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Semiconductors outperform the broad market after the Fed
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: SOX rose 1.69%; Nvidia gained 0.82%, AMD 1.65%, and TSM ADR 1.19% even as the S&P 500 fell 0.45%, showing continued stock-level resilience in AI hardware despite a higher discount rate.

breaking_news.headline: Fed raises rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, first hike since 2023
breaking_news.market_impact: The unanimous hike and SEP median fed-funds rate of 4.1% for 2026 point to roughly one additional 25bp hike by year-end if inflation persists; 10Y finished around 5.00%.

breaking_news.headline: US retail sales jump 1.2% and import prices rise 0.7%
breaking_news.market_impact: Demand remains resilient while imported inflation accelerates; import prices are up 7.0% y/y, reinforcing a higher-for-longer rate risk.

breaking_news.headline: WTI falls 3.2% to $102.43 as Saudi supply rerouting eases immediate fears
breaking_news.market_impact: Oil pulled back but remains above $100; energy inflation risk is lower at the margin, not resolved.

narration_points: Fed一致決議升息25bp至3.75%-4.00%，是2023年以來首次升息；SEP顯示2026年底政策利率中位數4.1%，約等於還有一次25bp升息空間。
宏觀數據不給Fed喘息：8月零售銷售+1.2%、控制組+1.4%；進口物價+0.7%、年增7.0%。10年債殖利率收在約5.00%，DXY升至約100.29。
能源略降溫：WTI正式結算102.43美元、-3.21%；但仍高於100美元。12月黃金期貨結算4387.50美元、+1.3%，Fed後現貨金反而轉跌。
半導體相對抗跌：SOX 11364.93 +1.69%，NVDA 213.90 +0.82%、AMD 512.50 +1.65%、TSM ADR 418.64 +1.19%；高利率下仍出現AI硬體相對強勢。
AI新訊號：Apple傳出研究M8 Ultra AI伺服器並考慮NVLink Fusion；Anthropic簽下澳洲2.16GW資料中心租約。需求還在，但電力與網路成本正在成為下一個瓶頸。
台股9/16反彈337.41點至45848.90，外資仍賣超179.8億元、連5賣；USD/TWD收31.888。外資TX淨OI由-83223回補至-76351。
台指期已換月到202610：9/16日盤收46078、+351點，近月OI 95896；9/17 session夜盤收46382、+322點（+0.70%），成交32283口。夜盤OI官方不發布，維持null。
財報面：Lennar EPS 1.19美元、營收80億美元，並下修全年交屋目標，顯示高房貸利率開始壓住房市；Trip.com基本營運仍成長，但反壟斷罰款造成帳面虧損。
120秒結論：Fed已正式重啟升息，10Y站上5%附近，但SOX與台指夜盤反而抗跌。下一步看9/17初領失業金、房屋數據與費城Fed，確認高利率是否開始更明顯傷害實體需求。
